advancedtechnologyservices-advancedtechn.description: Founded in 1985, ATS is a company with a presence in the United States, Mexico and the United Kingdom. We are professionals in Industrial Maintenance and we make factories run better. Fundada en 1985, ATS es una empresa con presencia en los Estados Unidos, México y el Reino Unido. Somos profesionales en mantenimiento industrial y hacemos que las fábricas funcionen mejor. Principal Duties/Responsibilities: · Performs entry to mid-level break-fix & preventative maintenance. This includes but not limited to: adjusting functional parts of devices and control instruments to sustain and improve operations; repairing or replacing defective parts; reconditioning or repairing machine tools. · Identifies needed parts, supplies, and repair items. · Provides support and back up for other members of department as needed by leadership. · Is aware of Maintenance Industry Standards. · Assures compliance with 5S and housekeeping standards. · Participates in CI activities - processes, results and cost savings. · May be required to setup and operate simple machining operations including but not limited to: lathe, drill press, grinder, and other metalworking tools to make and repair parts. May perform basic welding tasks. · Updates records and reviews CMMS history. · Performs basic troubleshooting of control systems circuitry. · Completes technical self-study programs for career development. · Follows all safety related policies, rules, regulations, technical instructions and guidelines. Situational awareness and identify unsafe behaviors and conditions. Knowledge, Skills, Abilities, & Behaviors Required: · High School Graduate or equivalent (GED). · Associates degree with a Technical focus or 18 months of related experience in general industry or successful completion of the ATS Technician Progression Program. · Understanding of basic electrical and mechanical systems. Can perform repairs. · Must be able to use basic hand tools. Physical Demands and Working Conditions: While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to stand; walk; use hands/fingers to handle, or feel; reach with hands and arms; climb, ascend/descend or balance to heights that may require a ladder or lift; stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl in confined spaces; and talk or hear. The employee is occasionally required to sit. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move more than 50 pounds. The employee is regularly required to use close vision and color vision. The employee is occasionally exposed to outside weather conditions and risk of electrical shock. Work is typically performed in a factory environment and is usually very loud. In the factory environment, the employee may be exposed to hazardous materials and/or greasy or slippery factory floors. ​ ATS believes in fair and equitable pay. Please note that actual salaries may vary within the range, or be above or below the range, based on factors including, but not limited to, education, training, experience, professional achievement, business need, and location. We also offer market leading benefit programs including Medical, Dental and Vision plans, PTO, a 401k retirement plans with employer matching, tuition reimbursement, and more. Pay Range $23.59 — $30.16 USD ATS is committed to providing equal employment opportunities in all aspects of employment to all applicants and employees without regard to age, color, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy, gender identity, and sexual orientation), national origin, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or other legally protected status. angellist-angellist:lever:7db555f5-5222-.description: Why Join AngelList We’re solving some of the hardest problems in venture capital and private markets. You’ll work with a team that values precision, urgency, and long-term thinking. If you want to shape how startups are funded and built, this is the place. About AngelList We exist to accelerate innovation by increasing the number of successful startups in the world. We do this by building the financial infrastructure that makes it easier for more people to invest in world-changing companies. AngelList is the nexus of venture capital and the startup community. We support $171B+ in assets and have powered investments into over 13,000 startups—over 300 of which are unicorns. Today, 57% of top-tier U.S. VC deals involve investors on AngelList. While our scale is large, our ambition is larger. If you're excited to build the future of private markets, come build with us. About the Role: The Principal Recruiter will support AngelList’s expanding business and strategic hiring goals. The right person will be a creative and adaptable generalist, capable of earning trust and delivering successful hires for key roles across the company. Instead of focusing on a single domain (or even isolating in technical or GTM roles), the Principal Recruiter will operate function-agnostic, and should be comfortable learning about every part of the business, ramping on a broad range of roles, and partnering with all executive team members. It will be a high-impact, high-exposure role, working closely with AngelList’s leadership. At AngelList, our mission is to accelerate innovation by empowering startups and the people who build them. And on our team, that starts with recruiting high-agency and high-curiosity builders to accelerate problem solving and business growth. This job isn't just about hiring — it's about putting the right people in the right seats so teams can outperform their goals.
qualifications: 8+ years of full lifecycle recruiting experience, including some startup experience
Ability to thrive and drive consensus and clarity in ambiguous and a fast-moving environments
An approach that leads with business outcomes over “activity”
Curiosity to leverage AI tools to automate day-to-day workflows and improve the speed and quality of the hiring process
Proven track record of success competing for elite talent in a competitive environment, and history of solid relationships in the industry
Ability to drive process and influence x-functionally to advance the ball despite any obstacles
Enthusiasm about growth, change, action, and refinement: the market moves quickly and so should you

cagents-cagents:lever:b000aaef-abb0-4be4.title: Reliability Field Engineer
cagents-cagents:lever:b000aaef-abb0-4be4.description: Position Description: As a Reliability Field Engineer, you are an integral part of our Operational Readiness team. You will coordinate, prepare, review and research equipment and material databases that allow out teams to recommend the best maintenance and asset management practices for our clients. If you enjoy hands-on experience while building your foundation of maintenance and reliability skillsets, this position is for you. Requirements include: Essential Duties and Responsibilities: Perform field walk-downs of systems and processes to collect or validate baseline equipment specification data Refine and load equipment information and engineering specifications into a database to achieve standardized records Collaborate with equipment manufacturers and vendors to develop unique parts lists Review maintenance data, engineering drawings, technical manuals, and other documentation to communicate associated reliability findings and recommendations Draft Failure Mode and Effect Analysis sheets (FMEA) on systems and equipment Perform all necessary quality control functions that are required to ensure that complete, accurate, and relevant data is provided to the customer Position Requirements: BS in an Engineering or Science field or equivalent experience 2+ years’ experience in process engineering, maintenance, and reliability or operational excellence, lean six sigma and TPM Ability to read Piping and Instrumentation Diagrams (P&ID) Ability to identify industrial equipment and record data in spreadsheets Ability to perform work with frequent interruptions and distractions. Ability to accomplish tasks by focusing on all areas involved; ensuring all associated processes and tasks are completed and accurate. Ability to effectively operate computer tablet and PC technology and software. Ability to interact and collaborate with others, both in person and through phone, e-mail, and written correspondence. Other Requirements: Excellent oral and written English is required Able to travel domestically and internationally if required Able to work (paid) overtime Able to work in the US without sponsorship now or any time or in the future About CAI CAI is a professional services company established in 1996 that has grown to more than 800 people worldwide. We provide commissioning, qualification, validation, start-up, project management and other consulting services associated with operational readiness to FDA regulated and other mission-critical industries. Are You Ready? Our approach is simple; we put the client’s interests first, we do not stop until it is right, and we will do whatever it takes to get there. As owners of CAI, we are committed to living our Foundational Principles, both professionally and personally: We act with integrity. We serve each other. We serve society. We work for our future. We work diligently to accomplish team goals. We place Team Before Self, demonstrate Respect for Others, and possess a Can-Do Attitude (our core values). That is how we have grown exponentially. Benefits Our full-time positions offer competitive compensation and benefits which include: 4% retirement contribution, 24 days PTO and 5 sick days per year, health insurance at extremely low cost to employee, financial support for both internal and external professional education as well as 70% long term disability paid for by the company. #LI-MV1

You deliver #bestincenter service, a company-wide standard for excellence in service, by sharing specialized knowledge in pastry techniques, baking fundamentals, and personalized instruction that supports all company initiatives. The Chef Instructor, Pastry plays a key role in inspiring a love for baking while driving sales of bakeware, mixers, and decorating tools through hands-on pastry classes and engaging culinary instruction. Performance is measured by key KPIs such as second-class sign-ups, retail culinary product sales, and guest feedback through Google reviews. Operations & Compliance · Ensure compliance with food safety standards, local health codes, and sanitation regulations. · Properly handle all tools, ingredients, and kitchen equipment to maintain a safe and efficient work environment. · Maintain accurate inventory levels, minimize shrink, and control supply and culinary expenses. · May handle liquor, wine, and beer in compliance with state and location alcohol regulations, company policies, including enforcing age restrictions. · Ensure store safety and cleanliness, addressing any maintenance needs promptly. · Adhere to applicable wage and hour laws. Accurately records time worked according to SLT Policy. · Model and ensure consistent adherence to all Sur La Table policies and standard operating procedures (SOPs). jobgether-jobgether:lever:77e3cbaa-b641-.title: Marketing Specialist, Social Media
jobgether-jobgether:lever:77e3cbaa-b641-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Marketing Specialist, Social Media based in Canada. This role offers the opportunity to shape the social voice and presence of well-known consumer brands in a fast-moving, highly visible environment. You will help turn marketing campaigns, cultural moments, and emerging trends into engaging social-first content. Working across organic and paid social, creator partnerships, and community management, you will play a hands-on role in growing reach and engagement. You will collaborate closely with internal marketing teams, creative partners, agencies, and influencers to bring ideas to life. The role combines creativity with performance analysis, using data and experimentation to continuously improve social campaigns. You will also help identify new platform trends and content opportunities that can strengthen brand relevance. This is an ideal opportunity for a social media professional who enjoys balancing creative execution, collaboration, and measurable business impact. Support the development and execution of social media strategies aligned with broader marketing objectives, helping increase traffic, engagement, reach, and conversions across digital and in-store channels. Manage the day-to-day execution of social media campaigns, coordinating with internal stakeholders and agency partners on content delivery, paid media, and scheduling. Develop and maintain monthly content calendars connected to marketing campaigns, promotions, cultural moments, and relevant social trends. Collaborate with creative teams and external partners to develop agile, low-fi, social-first content for platforms including Meta, TikTok, X, Snapchat, and LinkedIn. Capture and edit photo and video content when needed to support timely, platform-native social communication. Support creator and influencer campaigns, including briefing, coordination, content approvals, execution, and performance tracking. Monitor social media performance, analyze campaign metrics, prepare reports, and recommend optimization opportunities such as A/B testing and improvements to influencer strategies. Manage daily community interactions by responding to comments and direct messages, engaging with audiences, and monitoring brand sentiment. Track emerging platform features, creator trends, content formats, and cultural conversations to identify opportunities for timely and relevant brand participation. Contribute to a collaborative, creative, and continuously improving marketing environment while building strong relationships with internal and external partners. Requirements: Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related field. At least 2 years of experience in social media marketing , ideally within retail, convenience, QSR, consumer, or another fast-paced customer-facing industry. Demonstrated experience developing and executing social media campaigns that generate measurable engagement and audience growth. Strong understanding of social media platforms, content formats, audience engagement, and current digital trends. Experience with influencer or creator marketing and community management is an advantage. Ability to monitor, interpret, and report on social media performance metrics, using insights to inform optimization decisions. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with creative teams, agencies, influencers, and internal stakeholders. Creative mindset with an eye for compelling, social-first photo and video content. Ability to work independently, solve problems proactively, and manage multiple priorities in a rapidly changing environment. Cooperative, adaptable, and collaborative approach, with a genuine interest in continuous improvement. Benefits: Salary range of $60,000–$70,000 CAD annually. Full-time employment opportunity. Open to candidates across Canada. Hybrid

jobgether-jobgether:lever:7c165f9e-9e55-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Business / QA Analyst based in Brazil. This is a senior hybrid role combining business analysis, quality assurance, and Agile product delivery within a distributed international team. You will act as a key bridge between business stakeholders, product owners, and engineering teams, translating needs into clear and actionable requirements. The role covers the full product lifecycle, from workflow discovery and user stories through MVP delivery, testing, UAT, and post-release support. You will also help establish strong QA practices, design functional tests, manage defects, and identify opportunities for automation. Your work will directly contribute to delivering reliable digital solutions while keeping business priorities, quality standards, and project timelines aligned. The environment is collaborative, Scrum-based, remote-first, and highly international, with regular interaction across North American business hours. This opportunity is well suited to an experienced professional who combines strong analytical thinking with excellent communication and quality-focused execution. Collaborate with business stakeholders to understand, document, and improve operational workflows, identifying opportunities for new features and process enhancements. Elicit, analyze, and document business and functional requirements, translating them into clear user stories and acceptance criteria in Jira. Maintain traceability between business objectives, requirements, MVP definitions, and delivered functionality while keeping the team focused on project timelines. Translate expected application behavior and business processes into comprehensive functional test cases and execute manual testing. Establish and maintain QA practices, collaborating with QA Engineers on regression and performance testing and identifying opportunities for automation using tools such as Playwright. Log, prioritize, track, and manage defects through resolution, working closely with developers and Product Owners to address issues efficiently. Identify project risks, support mitigation planning, and monitor risks and issue-resolution progress throughout delivery. Lead User Acceptance Testing (UAT) to validate that solutions meet business requirements and expected user outcomes. Support beta testing by reproducing issues, coordinating with development teams, and monitoring product quality through release cycles. Contribute to change management activities, including training content creation, user communication, and product adoption support. Provide post-release and hypercare support, helping users troubleshoot issues and ensuring a smooth transition into new or updated solutions. Assess the potential business value of proposed enhancements and help prioritize initiatives within project constraints. Requirements: 8+ years of professional experience spanning Business Analysis and Quality Assurance , ideally within Agile environments such as Scrum or Kanban. Strong understanding of software development lifecycles, business analysis practices, QA methodologies, functional testing, and defect management. Hands-on familiarity with testing tools and test automation concepts; experience with Playwright is highly desirable. Strong ability to gather, analyze, and translate complex business requirements into user stories, functional specifications, and actionable test scenarios. Proven experience managing requirements and deliverables within strict project timelines and MVP constraints. Excellent analytical skills, strong attention to detail, and a structured approach to problem-solving. Familiarity with accounting and financial concepts. Strong communication, collaboration, and negotiation skills, with the ability to align technical teams, business stakeholders, and product leadership. Experience with Jira and Agile delivery practices. Ability to work effecti

Our partner is looking for a Urdu Language Interpreter based in India. This role is an opportunity to use your language expertise to facilitate clear and accurate communication between English- and Urdu-speaking customers or clients. You will interpret conversations precisely while ensuring that meaning, context, and intent are effectively conveyed between both languages. The position combines strong communication skills, active listening, cultural awareness, and a customer-focused mindset. You will join a collaborative and energetic remote environment that values teamwork, positivity, and an engaging work culture. Consistently meet defined quality objectives and contribute to maintaining high standards of service. rws-rws:lever:30647585-2cdf-4e2c-9329-4c.description: About the Role In this role, you will play a critical part in shaping the future of artificial intelligence and media analysis. Your main responsibility will be to review short-form video media and classify the language present in both spoken audio and on-screen text. By validating content within your native locale, you will generate high-quality "ground truth" data. Job Type: Freelance Location: India (work from home) Work Schedule: Part-time — 4 hours per day required. (Flexible schedule: you can choose your hours as long as the daily time requirement is met). Work whenever you want. Start Date: Immediately Duration: TBC Rate: 6 USD per hour What You’ll Do Media Evaluation: Watch and analyze short-form video clips to identify all languages present in the audio and on-screen text. Locale Validation: Verify and validate that the media content aligns with your specific target locale (e.g., verifying that the media content uses authentic target language and aligns with the cultural context of that language). Data Labeling: Generate highly accurate ground truth labels using our internal classification tools according to strict project guidelines. Quality Assurance: Ensure high data quality and consistency to meet the standards required for training automated machine learning models. What we’re looking for: Must be currently living in India. Native-level written and spoken fluency in Kannada. Access to a reliable, high-speed internet connection and a secure personal computer/laptop. Ability to strictly follow detailed photography and data entry guidelines. (Preferred but not required) Previous experience in data annotation, content moderation, translation, transcription, or linguistic QA is a strong asset.

thegialliancemanagementllccompany-thegia.title: Urology Physician, Spokane, WA
thegialliancemanagementllccompany-thegia.description: Urologist – Spokane Urology Spokane, Washington About Us Spokane Urology is the largest and longest-standing urology practice in Spokane and Spokane Valley, serving patients across the Inland Northwest since 1968. Our team of board-certified urologists and urologic oncologists is committed to thorough patient education, compassionate care, and delivering the full spectrum of advanced urologic treatment options. As a member of Urology Alliance (UA) , Spokane Urology is supported by a physician-led national network focused on patient-centered excellence, enabling our physicians to maintain local autonomy while benefiting from robust organizational and business infrastructure. Position Overview We are seeking a skilled and motivated Urologist to join our growing practice in Spokane, WA. This is an excellent opportunity for a physician who values clinical autonomy, practice growth, and the ability to build a long-term career in a high-volume, collegial private practice setting. We offer various employment models that suits the individual needs of the physician including part-time, employed, and partnership track with the opportunity to help care for a diverse urologic population across the region. Practice Model Spokane Urology combines the advantages of a mature, high-performing community practice with the support of a national network. Physicians enjoy a collaborative culture, access to modern outpatient surgery and clinic facilities, and a patient base that supports both general urology and subspecialty care. Clinic hours are structured to promote work-life balance, with Monday–Friday availability and shared call coverage. Key Responsibilities Provide comprehensive outpatient and procedural urologic care for adult men and women. Diagnose and treat a broad case mix, including BPH, kidney stones, incontinence, overactive bladder, men’s health, and urologic oncology. Perform office-based and operative procedures using state-of-the-art diagnostics and minimally invasive therapies. Collaborate with urologic oncologists and other physicians to determine the most appropriate treatment plan for each patient. Participate in shared call coverage and contribute to the continued growth of the practice. Qualifications MD or DO degree from an accredited medical school. Board certified or board eligible in Urology. Eligible for medical licensure in Washington state. Strong clinical skills in general urology and a commitment to high-quality, patient-centered care. Excellent communication, professionalism, and a team-oriented mindset. What We Offer Various employment statuses including Part-time, employed, or employed with partnership track. Local autonomy with the support of national resources through Urology Alliance. Generous financial package, including signing bonus, relocation assistance, and annual CME support based on employment status. Strong referral base and high clinical volume in a well-established market. Supportive, collaborative team culture with a focus on patient education and best-in-class care. Access to a desirable Pacific Northwest lifestyle with excellent outdoor recreation, family-friendly neighborhoods, and a lower cost of living than many West Coast metros. Why Spokane Spokane offers the feel of a vibrant smaller city with the amenities of a much larger metro. Physicians and families enjoy four-season outdoor recreation, great schools, a lively downtown, and convenient access through Spokane International Airport. It’s an ideal location for a physician seeking a long-term home, professional growth, and a strong quality of life. About Urology Alliance Urology Alliance is a physician-led, patient-focused network designed to help strong local practices thrive while preserving their identity and clinical autonomy. Through shared resources, operational support, and best practices, UA helps physician groups invest in growth, improve patient access, and build sustainable long-term success.
